    5: -------
    6: Numerically verify:
    7:  (i) WEIGHT-BALANCED ratio (a_m f_m) / (a_n f_n) with m, n sharing the same

   13:     Tr f(D^2/Λ^2) ~ Σ_{k ∈ Sd} f_k · Λ^k · a_{d-k}[D^2] / Γ(k/2)
   14: Our "weight label" is k (the Λ^k power). f_k is a single Mellin moment of f.
   15: If m, n share the same k (= "integer power of t" label), the ratio a_m/a_n · f_n/f_m
   16: is structurally independent of f.
   17: 
   18: We test three regulators:
   19:     f_A(u) = exp(-u)                         (Gaussian on λ)
   20:     f_B(u) = 1/(1+u)^2                       (polynomial cutoff)
   21:     f_C(u) = exp(-u^0.7)                     (stretched exponential)
   22: 
   23: We compute f_k numerically via the Mellin moment definition and check the
   24: claimed identity across regulators.
   25: 
   26: GATE sanity (not the proof itself): for WEIGHT-BALANCED (same k) pair, the
   27: ratio f_k^(A)/f_k^(B) = 1 structurally because it's the SAME moment; for an
   28: UNBALANCED (different k) pair, f_k/f_k' generically varies.

   30: (Not load-bearing: the theorem is analytic. This is just a sanity probe.)
